scene: A secret lever trips, unlocking three transit gates across the park.
picture: Flat side view along the wooden park deck. On the far left, a moving escalator ascends into the sky. Toward centre-left, the player in red bomber jacket and roller skates inspects the open brass panda. At centre, a ceramic noodle-cart monorail sits ready on its track. On the far right, a giant glowing paper-lantern balloon bobs gently.
shown: a humming escalator leading upward on the far left
a docked noodle-bowl monorail pod waiting in the centre
a tethered red paper-lantern hot-air balloon on the far right
